meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操控浏览器完成网页操作、填表、截图与数据抓取
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要操作网页,手动填表、截图或抓数据很耗时
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser tasks like form filling, screenshots, and data extraction.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often repeat browser chores like filling forms and grabbing data.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可通过命令行操作真实浏览器:打开网页、点击、填表、截图、提取信息、录屏等。它先抓取页面快照获得元素编号(如 @e1),再按编号点击或填写,也能等待元素、运行 JavaScript、保存登录状态。
howto.when: 当用户要求打开网页、填表、截图,或做类似的浏览器操作时触发。

say.text: 打开 example.com,把首页截图存下来。
say.note: 会执行 open 和 screenshot 命令。

say.text: 帮我在搜索框输入“天气”,然后点搜索按钮。
把当前页面上所有按钮的文字列出来。
say.note: 用 snapshot -i 获取可交互元素后逐个读取。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can drive a real browser via text commands: open pages, click, fill forms, take screenshots, extract data, record video, run JavaScript, and save login state. It first takes a snapshot to get element refs (like @e1), then acts on those refs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to open websites, fill forms, take screenshots, or perform other similar browser operations.

say_en.text: Open example.com and save a screenshot of the homepage.
Type "weather" into the search box and click the search button.
say_en.note: Uses snapshot refs, then fill and click.

say_en.text: List the text of all buttons on the current page.
say_en.note: Gets interactive elements from snapshot, then reads each.
